header.title: The areas we are building in.
header.lede: A live view of where Gelian is looking — overlooked value propositions under study and in development, each shaped toward a product, a service or a venture of its own. Nothing here is a committed investment or an operating business unless it says so.

legend.title: What each status means.
legend.lede: Every area carries a status, so this page stays honest about how far along each one really is.

closingCta.title: If something you are building belongs here, we should talk.
closingCta.body: We are interested in operators, makers and partners across every one of these areas — whether you are shaping a product, a service or a venture. Tell us what you are building and what you need that is not capital.
